annotations.title: Create outage alerts for a stack

description: START HERE to set up outage alerts for a user. One call, no account or API key. Creates an alert stack that notifies an email address (double opt-in: the recipient clicks one confirmation link) and/or a webhook URL (signed JSON; Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost and Rocket.Chat incoming-webhook URLs are auto-formatted when the host is recognizable) when any listed service goes down, stays degraded for N minutes, or gets N user reports in an hour, plus a recovery notice. Services accept slugs or common names ('openai', 'ChatGPT', 'Anthropic', 'AWS', 'Google Cloud'). If the user didn't say where alerts should go, ask for an email or a Slack, Teams, Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost or Rocket.Chat webhook URL first. Returns the stack id, a management token and a private manage_link, all shown ONCE: give the user the manage_link and tell them to keep it private.

components.description: Optional official component names to filter official/probe alerts (e.g. ['API']). Empty means all components. User-report alerts still fire even when a component filter is set.

degraded_minutes.description: Alert when degraded or down for at least this many minutes; null = off

digest_enabled.description: If true, send a weekly email digest of the last 7 days of outages to confirmed addresses on this stack.

email.description: Email address for alerts (recipient must click a confirmation link)

monitor_url.description: Optional https URL of a custom website to check on the existing alerts cadence (SSRF-protected, capped at 3 per stack).

notify_recovery.description: Also send a notice when the service recovers

on_down.description: Alert as soon as a service is Down (major outage)

opsgenie_api_key.description: Opsgenie API key. Stored on the stack and never returned.

pagerduty_routing_key.description: PagerDuty Events API v2 integration/routing key. Stored on the stack and never returned.

reports_per_hour.description: Alert when user reports in the last hour reach this; null = off

services.description: Services to watch: slugs or common names, e.g. ['openai', 'stripe', 'cloudflare']

share_enabled.description: If true, publish a read-only live status page at a public /s/pub_… URL (does not expose the private stack id). Default off.

share_index.description: If true, allow search engines to index the public status page. Requires share_enabled. Default off (noindex). Ignored when a share password is set.

share_password.description: Optional password for the public status page. The page stays unlisted. Password-protected pages cannot be embedded.

webhook_url.description: https URL to POST alerts to. Slack, Microsoft Teams (webhook.office.com / Power Automate), Google Chat, Discord, Mattermost (*.mattermost.com) and Rocket.Chat (*.rocket.chat) incoming webhooks are auto-formatted; other URLs get signed JSON. Self-hosted Mattermost or Rocket.Chat at a generic host can pass format explicitly via the API.
